business_scope.primary_industry_name: Creator Incubation and Multi-Channel Talent Representation

meta_jurisdiction_context.jurisdiction_name_en: Taiwan (Cross-Strait jurisdiction of the parent investor for the PRC WFOE formation)
meta_jurisdiction_context.legal_system_doctrine: Hybrid (civil-law foundation with PRC socialist regulatory overlay; Taiwan commercial law is civil-law based)
applicable_bilateral_investment_treaties: Cross-Strait Agreement on Investment Protection and Promotion (2012)
Cross-Strait Agreement on Avoidance of Double Taxation and Enhancement of Tax Cooperation (2015)

ubo_and_aml_profiling.statutory_law_governance: Anti-Money Laundering Law of the People's Republic of China (2024 revision, effective January 1, 2025); Measures for the Administration of Beneficial Owner Information of Legal Persons and Unincorporated Organizations (People's Bank of China and State Administration for Market Regulation, Order No. 3, effective November 1, 2024); applicable PBOC anti-money laundering and counter-terrorist financing rules for financial institutions and cross-border payment service providers.

mandatory_notarization_and_apostille_bun.document_name: Certificate of Incorporation of the Taiwan-National Parent Investor
mandatory_notarization_and_apostille_bun.issuing_entity: Ministry of Economic Affairs, Taiwan (Company Registration Bureau)
mandatory_notarization_and_apostille_bun.authentication_path: Taiwan-origin certificate destined for mainland China use: notarization by a Taiwan district-court notary, certification by the Straits Exchange Foundation (SEF), and verification by the Association for Relations Across the Taiwan Straits (ARATS). This cross-strait verification route is exclusive; no Hague Apostille and no consular legalization may be chained to it. For a PRC-issued certificate used abroad, the parallel route is PRC notarial authentication then a Hague Apostille only.

mandatory_notarization_and_apostille_bun.document_name: Certificate of Good Standing / Business Registration Certificate of the Taiwan-National Parent Investor
mandatory_notarization_and_apostille_bun.issuing_entity: Ministry of Economic Affairs, Taiwan or authorized commercial registration authority
mandatory_notarization_and_apostille_bun.authentication_path: Parallel and mutually exclusive paths: Hague Apostille route for documents issued in an Apostille Convention state; Consular Legalization route for non-member jurisdictions. Because Taiwan is not an Apostille member, Taiwan-issued certificates are processed through Consular Legalization where a consular channel exists, and for PRC filing through SEF/ARATS cross-strait verification. Never execute a Hague Apostille and Consular Legalization sequentially.

mandatory_notarization_and_apostille_bun.document_name: Board Resolution and Power of Attorney appointing the PRC Legal Representative and Authorized Signatories
mandatory_notarization_and_apostille_bun.issuing_entity: Board of directors / chairman of the Taiwan-National Parent Investor; notarized in Taiwan
mandatory_notarization_and_apostille_bun.authentication_path: Precise sequence for mainland China: Taiwan notary public notarization of the board resolution and power of attorney; SEF certification; ARATS verification; and submission to the local PRC Market Regulatory Bureau and bank. The Hague Apostille path is unavailable for Taiwan-origin instruments and may not be paired with Consular Legalization; each authentication route is used exclusively according to the document's origin and destination state.

mandatory_notarization_and_apostille_bun.document_name: Articles of Association / Memorandum of Incorporation of the Taiwan-National Parent Investor
mandatory_notarization_and_apostille_bun.issuing_entity: Taiwan-National Parent Investor and notarizing authority in Taiwan
mandatory_notarization_and_apostille_bun.authentication_path: Taiwan-origin constitutive documents must follow the notarization, SEF certification, and ARATS verification route for use in the PRC WFOE registration file. If the same document is to be used in another Hague Apostille member state, the only valid authentication would be a Taiwan-issued apostille if Taiwan had member status; as Taiwan is non-member, Consular Legalization through the destination state's competent authority is the applicable route, never both.

mandatory_notarization_and_apostille_bun.document_name: Bank Reference Letter including account relationship, source-of-funds confirmation, and transaction history summary from the Taiwan Parent's corporate bank
mandatory_notarization_and_apostille_bun.authentication_path: The bank reference letter must be issued on original bank letterhead and signed by an authorized bank officer; the accompanying notarized signatory authority certificate must be verified through SEF/ARATS for mainland China use. If the issuing bank is located in a Hague Apostille state, the signatory certificate may instead bear a single Hague Apostille; the opening bank letter itself is not apostilled or consularized, and the two mechanisms are mutually exclusive.

mandatory_notarization_and_apostille_bun.document_name: Certificate of Good Standing / Criminal Record or Compliance Statement for each UBO and director
mandatory_notarization_and_apostille_bun.issuing_entity: Taiwan district court or relevant public prosecutor's office / police certificates for natural persons
mandatory_notarization_and_apostille_bun.authentication_path: The UBO and director compliance statement is a natural-person certificate. For use in mainland China, each page must be notarized by a Taiwan notary, certified by SEF, and verified by ARATS. For use in a Hague Apostille state, the natural-person certificate must be authenticated by the Taiwan competent authority and then receive a Hague Apostille; Consular Legalization is used only in non-Apostille states. These routes are parallel and mutually exclusive.

ubo_and_aml_profiling.pep_and_sanctions_screening_protocols: The protocol requires that every natural person owning 25% or more, all directors, legal representatives, authorized signatories, and final beneficial owners be screened against the UN Security Council consolidated sanctions list, the OFAC SDN and Sectoral Sanctions Identifications lists, the EU consolidated financial sanctions list, the PRC List of Untrustworthy Entities, and PRC and Taiwan domestic counter-money-laundering watchlists before acceptance of the mandate. Positive PEP status triggers senior management approval, enhanced due diligence, source-of-wealth documentation, and ongoing transaction monitoring. Any sanctioned-party hit automatically halts formation pending bank and regulatory guidance.

statutory_name_clearance_protocol.registry_portal_name: National Enterprise Credit Information Publicity System and local State Administration for Market Regulation (SAMR) online enterprise name clearance portal
statutory_name_clearance_protocol.language_and_transliteration_doctrine: The registered China WFOE name must follow the statutory four-tier structure: administrative division plus distinctive trade name plus industry or operating description plus legal form suffix (Limited Liability Company). The name must be written in Simplified Chinese characters; Traditional Chinese, Latin characters, Arabic numerals, and English words are not permitted in the registered name. A pinyin phonetic transliteration of the Taiwan parent's corporate name may be used as the distinctive component where it does not mislead the public, but the exact registered name must conform to SAMR name rules.
statutory_name_clearance_protocol.extension_and_rejection_appeal_sop: Upon name rejection, the applicant must first correct the proposed name or rectify the conflicting distinctive element and resubmit through the SAMR name clearance portal. If the rejection is based on public interest, ministerial approval, or similarity, the applicant may file a written administrative reconsideration application with the superior SAMR within 60 days of the rejection notice, and may later initiate an administrative lawsuit under the PRC Administrative Litigation Law within six months. The 30-day name reservation is not automatically extended; a fresh online application must be filed before expiration if registration is not completed.

incorporation_legal_framework.governing_statute_and_sections: Company Act of the Republic of China (Taiwan), Articles 129, 131, 156, 183, 192, 208 and 387; Foreign Investment Act, Articles 7-10; and Regulations Governing Investment by Mainland Investors in Taiwan, Article 8.
incorporation_legal_framework.competent_registry_authority: Department of Commerce, Ministry of Economic Affairs; Company and Commercial Registration System (CCRS), with foreign-investment pre-clearance by the Investment Commission, Ministry of Economic Affairs.
incorporation_legal_framework.statutory_filing_instrument: Company Incorporation Registration Application together with the notarized Articles of Incorporation filed through the Company and Commercial Registration System.
incorporation_legal_framework.minimum_paid_up_capital_rule: No general statutory minimum paid-up capital applies to a Taiwan foreign-invested limited company engaged in digital services; however, the Investment Commission requires declared capital to be commensurate with the intended MCN agency business scope and operating expenses. The full subscribed capital must be remitted into a dedicated bank account opened in Taiwan in the proposed company name, and a bank-issued Certificate of Deposit must be produced. The account remains a blocked escrow-type account until the Department of Commerce issues the Company Registration Certificate. For a People's Republic of China mainland investor, the capital remittance must be made through an approved cross-strait foreign exchange channel and is subject to Investment Commission review of the ultimate beneficial ownership structure.
incorporation_legal_framework.pro_forma_first_board_resolution_en: RESOLUTIONS OF THE FIRST BOARD OF DIRECTORS OF CN_WFOE_LTD (THE COMPANY), ADOPTED BY THE FOUNDING SHAREHOLDER AND THE SUBSCRIBED DIRECTORS ON [DATE], AT TAIPEI, TAIWAN, REPUBLIC OF CHINA. WHEREAS, the Company was organized under the Company Act of the Republic of China, the Foreign Investment Act, and all applicable administrative regulations, and the founding shareholder has subscribed for the entire initial share capital; and WHEREAS, the Company intends to carry on a creator-incubation, multi-channel talent-representation and digital content agency business within the Republic of China and to be registered as a foreign-invested limited company; NOW, THEREFORE, BE IT RESOLVED, that: 1. SHARE CAPITAL SUBSCRIPTION. The subscription by the founding shareholder of all ordinary shares at a par value of NT$10 per share, for an aggregate paid-in capital of NT$[AMOUNT], be and is hereby ratified and confirmed. The full amount of the subscribed capital shall be remitted to the dedicated subscription bank account and shall remain frozen until the Department of Commerce grants the Company Registration Certificate. 2. REGISTERED OFFICE. The registered office of the Company shall be fixed and adopted at [ADDRESS], and such office shall be the principal place of statutory service in Taiwan. The officers are directed to sign the lease and to maintain the corporate seal and statutory books at such address. 3. BANKING AUTHORIZATION. The Board hereby appoints [BANK NAME], Taipei branch, as the Company's principal banker. Any two Directors, one being the General Manager, or such other authorized signatories as may be named in the bankers' mandate, shall jointly sign cheques, bank transfers, foreign exchange applications, and other banking documents. The Company Secretary is directed to execute the mandate in accordance with the bank's requirements. 4. STATUTORY OFFICER APPOINTMENTS. The following officers are hereby appointed: [NAME], Chairman of the Board; [NAME], General Manager; [NAME], Chief Financial Officer; and [NAME], Company Secretary. These officers shall exercise all duties required by the Company Act and by internal rules of the Company. The Chairman and the Company Secretary are, jointly and severally, authorized to prepare, sign, and file the incorporation registration application, to make all statutory declarations, to pay all official fees, and to resolve any queries raised by the authorities. 5. RESIDUARY DELEGATION. All actions already taken by the promoters in connection with the formation and registration of the Company are ratified and approved, and the officers are delegated all legal powers necessary to complete the incorporation, licensing, banking, labor insurance and post-registration compliance steps. 6. EFFECTIVENESS. This resolution shall take effect immediately upon signing and shall continue in full force until amended by a subsequent board resolution. PASSED AND ADOPTED this [DATE].

step_by_step_formation_sop.step_name: Pre-incorporation Name Reservation and Investment Commission Pre-approval
step_by_step_formation_sop.competent_authority: Investment Commission, Ministry of Economic Affairs; Company and Commercial Registration System (CCRS) online name reservation portal.
step_by_step_formation_sop.detailed_action_protocol: Submit an on-line name reservation through the Ministry of Economic Affairs Company Registration System and, on the same portal or in a separate filing with the Investment Commission, request foreign-investment pre-approval under the Foreign Investment Act, identifying the People's Republic of China-resident ultimate beneficial owner and the planned creator-representation and MCN agency business. Describe the absence of physical plant, specify the initial paid-in capital and banking source, and upload notarially certified parent-company documents with an accompanying sworn translation. The name reservation should be secured before the incorporation filing; the investment permission decision must also be issued before the Department of Commerce will accept final incorporation documents.
required_dossiers: Foreign Investment or Mainland Investor Permission Application
Parent company board resolution authorizing investment
Sworn Chinese translation of foreign documents
step_by_step_formation_sop.adverse_action_remedies: If the name is rejected as identical or confusingly similar, submit up to three alternative names generated by the CCRS name classifier. If investment permission is queried, file a supplemental UBO declaration and revised business plan within 10 working days of the query.

step_by_step_formation_sop.step_name: Notarization of Articles and Blocked Capital Escrow
step_by_step_formation_sop.competent_authority: Taiwan District Court Notary Office or licensed private notary; designated local bank in Taipei.
step_by_step_formation_sop.detailed_action_protocol: Draft the Articles of Incorporation in both Chinese and English with the subscribed share capital, shareholder list, director appointments, and registered office address. Arrange for the founding shareholder to execute the Articles before a Taiwan District Court notary or licensed private notary, and open a dedicated paid-in capital bank account at a Taiwanese domestic bank in the proposed company name. Remit the subscribed capital into that account by wire transfer, obtain a bank-issued Certificate of Deposit evidencing the balance, and keep the funds in that blocked escrow-type account until the company registration certificate is issued. Certified true copies of the Articles must be prepared for subsequent filing with the Ministry of Economic Affairs.
required_dossiers: Draft Chinese and English Articles of Incorporation
Bank account opening application for the proposed company
step_by_step_formation_sop.adverse_action_remedies: If the notary refuses certification due to incomplete foreign documents, obtain legalization by the Taiwan representative authority in the overseas jurisdiction. If the bank rejects account opening under AML, provide a further source-of-funds statement and the ultimate beneficial owner's passport and business background.

step_by_step_formation_sop.step_name: Company Registration Filing with the Department of Commerce
step_by_step_formation_sop.competent_authority: Department of Commerce, Ministry of Economic Affairs; Company and Commercial Registration System (CCRS).
step_by_step_formation_sop.detailed_action_protocol: Using the Company Registration System, file the incorporation application with the Department of Commerce, attaching the notarized Articles, name reservation approval, investment permission letter, bank certificate of deposit, shareholder and director identification documents, and the first board resolution appointing officers. Pay the statutory registration fee by credit card or e-payment in the portal. The registrar will review the application for formal compliance, business scope legality, and capital verification; upon approval, issue a Company Registration Certificate and the corporate identification code. If a deficiency notice is issued, the representative must upload a supplementary explanation and corrected pages through the same portal within seven days; failure to respond leads to suspension and possible rejection.
required_dossiers: Paid-in capital bank Certificate of Deposit
Registered office address verification or lease
step_by_step_formation_sop.adverse_action_remedies: If the Department of Commerce suspends the application for deficiency, respond within 7 days online and resubmit the corrected instrument; if business scope is questioned, amend the Articles to narrow to digital content and advertising services and renotarize only the amended article.

step_by_step_formation_sop.step_name: Business Registration and Tax Registration with National Taxation Bureau
step_by_step_formation_sop.competent_authority: National Taxation Bureau, Taipei branch, Ministry of Finance.
step_by_step_formation_sop.detailed_action_protocol: Within fifteen days of company registration, register the Taiwan head office with the local National Taxation Bureau to obtain the Unified Business Number and to formalize VAT and e-invoice status. File the Business Registration Application together with the company certificate, registered office lease or proof of premises, the incorporation certificate, and a statement of business activities confirming that the MCN agency will provide creator-representation, digital-advertising, and talent-consulting services. The tax authority will assess the business as a services taxpayer, authorizing uniform invoice issuance and zero-rated or exempt treatment for cross-border digital payouts. Maintain rental agreements, vendor contracts, and beneficial-ownership declarations for the tax file.
step_by_step_formation_sop.adverse_action_remedies: If the tax bureau queries business scope, file a written explanation and an independent accountant's cover letter proving the operation is services, not physical production; if e-invoice setup is delayed, request monthly temporary sales reporting and reconcile after normal issuance is activated.

step_by_step_formation_sop.step_name: Corporate Bank Account Activation and Post-Registration Statutory Filings
step_by_step_formation_sop.competent_authority: Designated corporate bank, Bureau of Labor Insurance, Central Health Insurance Agency, and local labor administration office.
step_by_step_formation_sop.detailed_action_protocol: After company registration and tax registration are complete, present the corporate seal and board resolution at the designated bank to activate the company bank account, execute the bankers' mandate under any two signatories, and enable corporate online banking together with Wise B2B payout rails for TikTok creator remittances. Simultaneously, enroll the company as an employer at the Bureau of Labor Insurance and the Central Health Insurance Agency, open a labor-pension account, and file required employee declarations. Review whether any municipal digital-content authorization or audio-visual trade license applies to MCN activities; if none applies, record that conclusion. Finally, deposit copies of all permits, the certificate of deposit, company seal, and minutes in the statutory records location.
required_dossiers: Employer registration forms for labor and health insurance
Lease and fire-safety proof for office
step_by_step_formation_sop.adverse_action_remedies: If the bank requires more compliance, supply the full beneficial-ownership register and a board-certified banking mandate; if labor registration is late, use the labor insurance bureau's administrative correction procedure to backdate coverage to the first hiring day.

industry_physical_and_environmental_lice.competent_industrial_authority: Not Applicable; no physical manufacturing, chemical, assembly, or warehousing operation under ISIC 7310 and NAICS 541810 for a global TikTok MCN agency.
industry_physical_and_environmental_lice.operating_license_title: Not Applicable; no statutory industrial operating license required for pure digital creator-representation and multi-channel talent agency services.

environmental_impact_assessment_eia.agency_name: Environmental Protection Administration, Taiwan - Not Applicable
environmental_impact_assessment_eia.classification_tier: Exempt; pure digital MCN agency generating no industrial air, water, solid waste, or hazardous materials streams.
environmental_impact_assessment_eia.discharge_and_emissions_standards: Not Applicable; no industrial wastewater discharge, zero VOC-emitting manufacturing equipment, and no hazardous waste handling; office municipal solid waste only.

industry_physical_and_environmental_lice.civil_defense_and_occupational_clearance: Not Applicable at industrial level; general office premises must nevertheless comply with the Fire Services Act, including fire extinguishers, emergency lighting and clear egress routes, and with routine self-inspection obligations under the Occupational Safety and Health Act.

national_tax_registration_infrastructure.competent_tax_authority: State Taxation Administration (STA) of the People's Republic of China; electronic filing and administration through the National Electronic Tax Administration Bureau (e-Tax) online portal and the STA invoice service platform (Golden Tax Project Phase IV).
national_tax_registration_infrastructure.tax_id_procurement_sop: Upon entity formation, the WFOE first obtains its Unified Social Credit Code (USCC) from the Administration for Market Regulation; the USCC is automatically the legal person's taxpayer identification number (TIN). The WFOE must complete post-incorporation tax registration, tax type determination, and invoicing quota approval through the e-Tax portal within 30 days of business license issuance. For a foreign non-resident enterprise without a registered Chinese establishment but earning PRC-source taxable income, the PRC payer or withholding agent files the Tax Withholding Return and makes the payment to the STA; where the non-resident entity requires direct registration, it must file a non-resident enterprise tax registration with the competent tax authority, submitting foreign incorporation proof, tax residency certificate, board or legal representative identification, articles of association, and Chinese bank account details to be assigned a non-resident taxpayer identification number.
national_tax_registration_infrastructure.statutory_election_mechanisms: None. PRC tax law does not provide check-the-box elections for entity classification or hybrid mismatch elections; a WFOE is mandatorily a PRC resident enterprise taxed at entity level. VAT status as general versus small-scale taxpayer is elective only within statutory conditions and does not affect income tax classification.

indirect_taxation_nexus_and_rules.indirect_tax_system_name: Value-Added Tax (VAT) of the People's Republic of China, governed by the PRC VAT Law and supplementary fiscal regulations, including Caishui [2016] No. 36 for cross-border services.
indirect_taxation_nexus_and_rules.statutory_registration_threshold_local_c: RMB 5,000,000 in annual taxable sales excluding VAT. Taxpayers whose annual taxable sales exceed this amount are mandatorily registered as general VAT taxpayers; below the threshold they remain small-scale taxpayers. Initial VAT and tax registration itself is mandatory for all WFOEs as part of the one-stop business establishment procedure, irrespective of turnover.
indirect_taxation_nexus_and_rules.electronic_invoicing_and_clearance_manda: China uses the National Electronic Invoice Service Platform for fully digitalized e-invoices and the tax-controlled special VAT invoice system for VAT special invoices. All invoice data must be issued through STA-approved channels with the tax-control U-Key or digital e-invoice authentication, transmitted to the Golden Tax Project Phase IV platform, and automatically matched against VAT filings, customs export declarations, and foreign exchange receipts. Anti-fraud controls include mandatory invoice serial numbers, QR-code verification, encrypted invoice metadata, and automated risk identification; there is no private offline invoice software permitted for statutory VAT invoices.

export_zero_rating_and_refund_substantia.zero_rating_eligibility: Goods exported from China are zero-rated for VAT if they are physically shipped out of China, customs release is granted, and the seller retains the required export declaration and sales and payment evidence. Cross-border services are zero-rated or VAT-exempt only when supplied to an overseas entity and wholly consumed outside China under Caishui [2016] No. 36; zero-rating applies to specified offshore service categories such as software, information systems, business process management, and certain R&D and design services, while MCN and advertising services with the advertising placement outside China fall under the exemption category unless separately classified as a zero-rated offshore service. The taxpayer must prove the offshore recipient, actual overseas consumption, foreign-currency consideration, and absence of domestic use or benefit; zero-rated supplies allow input VAT credit and refund, while VAT-exempt cross-border services do not.
mandatory_customs_documentation_bundle: Customs Export Goods Declaration (export customs release form) evidencing physical export
Bill of Lading, Air Waybill, or other international transport document covering the exported goods
Commercial invoice and export sales contract
Packing list and export customs inspection records where applicable
Bank inward foreign exchange collection slip or FX settlement proof issued by a designated foreign exchange bank
Offshore service performance evidence or overseas advertising placement report for cross-border service exemption or zero-rating
export_zero_rating_and_refund_substantia.audit_scrutiny_and_clawback_penalties: STA, customs, and SAFE data-exchange programs cross-match export declarations, logistics documents, e-invoices, VAT returns, and foreign exchange receipts. If a claimed zero percent export VAT rate or exemption is not fully substantiated, the authority denies the zero rating, reclaims any refunded input VAT, and assesses output VAT with a late-payment surcharge at 0.05 percent per day; administrative penalties may be 50 percent to 500 percent of the unpaid tax under the Law on the Administration of Tax Collection and Tax Levying. Fraudulent or deceptive export VAT refund applications are criminal tax fraud under the PRC Criminal Law and are not subject to a time-limited recovery period; responsible officers may face criminal imprisonment and property confiscation.

fx_control_regime_and_central_bank_regul.central_bank_authority: People's Bank of China (PBOC) and the State Administration of Foreign Exchange (SAFE)
fx_control_regime_and_central_bank_regul.currency_convertibility_assessment: Under the foreign exchange administration of the People's Republic of China, the RMB is fully convertible for current account transactions such as trade in goods, services, and remittance of employee compensation, provided that underlying documentation is submitted through a designated bank. Capital account transactions, including foreign direct investment into a WFOE, the servicing of offshore loans, and the repatriation of registered capital or dividends, remain subject to strict prior approval, SAFE filing, or bank-verification-based control. The WFOE may lawfully receive foreign exchange capital contributions after completing the Foreign Investment Information Report, opening a SAFE-monitored capital account, and passing bank KYC. Funds credited to the capital account may be converted into CNY for operating purposes within the permitted business scope, but cannot be used for equity investment or offshore lending without special approval. Profit remittances to foreign shareholders require audited financial statements, tax clearance, and evidence that paid-in capital has been fully injected. The regime is therefore a managed convertibility system rather than a free capital account regime.
fx_control_regime_and_central_bank_regul.export_proceeds_surrender_rules: Under SAFE's trade-in-goods monitoring rules, export proceeds must be repatriated to a domestic foreign exchange settlement account no later than 90 days from customs declaration unless a longer contractual term is registered and justified. China has abolished mandatory foreign exchange surrender; the mandatory conversion ratio is zero percent, meaning that a WFOE may retain 100% of export proceeds in foreign exchange. Conversion to CNY requires a valid trade background and supporting customs documents.

corporate_banking_onboarding_blueprint.fintech_emi_cross_border_viability: Offshore digital EMIs such as Wise, Airwallex, and WorldFirst are not licensed commercial banks or lawful deposit-taking institutions in mainland China. Under the PBOC Licensing Framework for Payment Institutions, no non-bank institution can operate a domestic clearing account, accept RMB deposits, or provide foreign exchange settlement on behalf of a Chinese WFOE without obtaining a Payment Business Permit and joining the China clearing infrastructure. Therefore, the WFOE cannot use an offshore EMI as its primary treasury account for statutory paid-in capital or dividend repatriation. EMIs may be employed only as auxiliary collection or payout portals if funds pass through a domestic licensed bank and the transaction is reported under SAFE; otherwise their services create suspicious activity reports and foreign exchange filing gaps. Consequently, onshore Tier-1 banks are mandatory for risk control and regulatory reliability.
corporate_banking_onboarding_blueprint.physical_presence_and_kyc_interview_mand: Statutory legal representatives and at least one senior director must appear in person at a designated mainland Chinese bank branch for the initial corporate account opening. Remote consular proxy opening is not generally permitted for the initial KYC. If the legal representative cannot travel, an authorized manager may attend with a notarized power of attorney, original passport or Taiwan Compatriot Permit, and the bank may conduct a live video interview with the absent director. In all cases, the beneficial ownership chain must be disclosed to the bank's compliance committee before activation.

critical_aml_kyc_blockers_and_defense.trigger_point: Ultimate Beneficial Owner opacity through Taiwan cross-strait investment vehicles and nominee shareholder structures.
critical_aml_kyc_blockers_and_defense.evidentiary_defense_dossier: Full organizational chart identifying all natural-person UBOs holding 25% or more of the WFOE; notarized certificate of incorporation and shareholder register of the Taiwan parent; passport or national ID copies; source of wealth and source of funds dossiers including audited financial statements, bank references, and tax returns for each UBO.

critical_aml_kyc_blockers_and_defense.trigger_point: Revenue inconsistency between declared MCN service contracts and TikTok platform payout records, creating misstatement or false invoicing concerns.
critical_aml_kyc_blockers_and_defense.evidentiary_defense_dossier: Executed creator management agreements with TikTok creator IDs; platform payout statements and settlement reconciliation; invoices issued by the WFOE; bank statements evidencing receipt of service fees; and a monthly creator payout ledger reconciled to the bank's transaction records and tax withholding certificates.

critical_aml_kyc_blockers_and_defense.trigger_point: Payments to creators domiciled in sanctioned jurisdictions, tax havens, or shell financial centers, particularly where virtual advertising and talent fees are involved.
critical_aml_kyc_blockers_and_defense.evidentiary_defense_dossier: Completed sanctions screening results from a reputable OFAC/EU/UN screening tool; passport and residential address proof for every payee creator; a beneficial ownership declaration from each payee; employment or independent contractor agreements; and a written no-sanctions compliance policy signed by the WFOE's AML compliance officer.

critical_aml_kyc_blockers_and_defense.trigger_point: High-volume, low-value creator payout transfers structured below reporting thresholds, potentially indicating layering or micro-structuring.
critical_aml_kyc_blockers_and_defense.evidentiary_defense_dossier: Full creator payee list with KYC files; payout schedule and frequency analysis; audit trail from TikTok's creator dashboard; payroll or royalty computation worksheets; board-approved compensation policy; and bank statements showing all outbound wire transfers with transaction narration linked to underlying creator contracts.

cross_border_liquidity_and_clearing_rail.inbound_capital_injection_routing: Route via a designated domestic Tier-1 bank under SAFE FDI registration. The Taiwan shareholder must remit TWD or USD using SWIFT MT103 to the WFOE's foreign exchange capital account, with the SAFE-mapped BOP Direct Investment Equity purpose code and remittance remarks stating WFOE Registered Capital Injection. The receiving bank must verify the SAFE FDI equity registration number, the shareholder name and interest matching, and the amount against the approved registered capital. Funds must be received within the validity period of the investment confirmation; the WFOE then obtains a capital verification report from a licensed PRC certified public accountant and updates the SAFE foreign exchange business system before the funds are used for operating purposes.
cross_border_liquidity_and_clearing_rail.outbound_trade_disbursements: Creator disbursements and international service payments should be executed through SWIFT MT103 with complete beneficiary KYC, tax withholding proof, and underlying MCN contracts. Commercial letters of credit and documentary collections are permissible for ancillary goods transactions such as branded merchandise, but are not appropriate for intangible creator management services. For cross-strait RMB payments, use CIPS or RMB clearing in Hong Kong. All outbound payments above the relevant regulatory monitoring threshold require BOP statistical declaration and must maintain a full audit trail.
permissible_fx_hedging_instruments: Onshore deliverable RMB/FX forward contracts with licensed banks, supported by a genuine current or capital account exposure and SAFE real-demand validation
FX swaps and cross-currency swaps where the WFOE has a matching foreign-currency debt or future receivables exposure
Vanilla FX options with upfront premium payment, subject to bank credit approval and real-demand documentation
Offshore NDFs are not permissible for onshore WFOEs; participation requires a licensed overseas entity and cannot be booked domestically

annual_compliance_calendar_matrix.statutory_deliverable: Annual Company Registration Certificate Renewal and Foreign Enterprise Filing
annual_compliance_calendar_matrix.receiving_authority: Ministry of Economic Affairs (MOEA), Department of Commerce, Taiwan
annual_compliance_calendar_matrix.statutory_deadline_window: On or before the anniversary of the company's incorporation date annually; filings accepted no earlier than 30 days prior to the anniversary date
annual_compliance_calendar_matrix.delinquency_sanctions: Late filing surcharge of NTD 1,000 (approximately USD 33) per month or part thereof, up to a maximum of NTD 10,000 (approximately USD 330); repeated failure may trigger a notice of statutory deregistration and administrative strike-off by the MOEA.

annual_compliance_calendar_matrix.statutory_deliverable: Annual Income Tax Return and Corporate Income Tax Filing
annual_compliance_calendar_matrix.receiving_authority: National Taxation Bureau, Ministry of Finance, Taiwan (Taiwan Tax Administration)
annual_compliance_calendar_matrix.statutory_deadline_window: Filing period: May 1 through May 31 of the year following the taxable calendar year
annual_compliance_calendar_matrix.delinquency_sanctions: Additional income tax of 10% of the underpaid amount if overdue without cause; interest at the postal savings interest rate per annum on unpaid taxes accruing from the original due date; continued delinquency can result in a freeze on bank accounts and a tax lien, and in severe cases a court-referred compulsory enforcement and business deregistration.

annual_compliance_calendar_matrix.statutory_deliverable: Business Tax (VAT-like) Monthly or Quarterly Filing and Annual Adjustment Return
annual_compliance_calendar_matrix.receiving_authority: Local National Taxation Bureau, Ministry of Finance, Taiwan
annual_compliance_calendar_matrix.statutory_deadline_window: Monthly or bi-monthly (every two months) filing within 15 days after the end of each filing period, and an annual adjustment filing on or before the same due date in May of the following year
annual_compliance_calendar_matrix.delinquency_sanctions: A penalty of 1% of the unpaid tax amount for each two months overdue, up to a maximum of 10%; for cases with intent to evade tax, a penalty up to 5 times the underpaid amount; failure to file may lead to a demand notice, interest, and enforcement and restriction on business activities.

annual_compliance_calendar_matrix.statutory_deliverable: Annual Employee Social Insurance and Labor Pension Contribution Report
annual_compliance_calendar_matrix.receiving_authority: Bureau of Labor Insurance, Ministry of Labor, Taiwan; Bureau of Labor Funds, Taiwan
annual_compliance_calendar_matrix.statutory_deadline_window: Monthly contribution statements due by the end of the following month; annual wage adjustment and contribution ceiling declaration due each year by early September or as announced by the Ministry of Labor
annual_compliance_calendar_matrix.delinquency_sanctions: Delayed contribution surcharges of 0.1% per day up to a maximum of 20%; failure to file accurate wage reports can lead to fines up to NTD 100,000 (approximately USD 3,300) per violation and potentially criminal liability for fraudulent underreporting.

annual_compliance_calendar_matrix.statutory_deliverable: Annual Uniform Invoice and Bookkeeping Records Certification (Tax Bookkeeping Audit)
annual_compliance_calendar_matrix.receiving_authority: National Taxation Bureau, Ministry of Finance, Taiwan
annual_compliance_calendar_matrix.statutory_deadline_window: Books, accounts, and supporting vouchers for the preceding business year must be retained and made available for inspection upon notification; annual tax bookkeeping examination generally completed within the May filing window and upon request by the tax authority
annual_compliance_calendar_matrix.delinquency_sanctions: Penalty of 5% of tax understatement if invoices or account records are found false or incomplete; failure to maintain statutory books may result in fines from NTD 30,000 to NTD 300,000 (approximately USD 1,000 to 10,000) and re-audit or strike-off in aggravated cases.

statutory_audit_and_accounting_mandate.compulsory_audit_thresholds: An independent CPA financial statement audit is legally mandatory for Taiwan companies in the following cases: (1) all companies with issued share capital exceeding NTD 30 million (approximately USD 1 million); (2) companies with paid-in capital exceeding NTD 100 million (approximately USD 3.3 million); (3) companies that have issued bonds, debentures, or other debt securities in the market; (4) companies qualifying as large enterprises under the Company Act or the Commercial Accounting Act with annual turnover exceeding NTD 100 million (approximately USD 3.3 million) or total assets exceeding NTD 300 million (approximately USD 10 million); and (5) financial institutions, insurance companies, and other enterprises specially designated by the Financial Supervisory Commission. A company that does not cross the mandatory threshold may nonetheless be required to undergo audit if it receives a notice from the tax authority or the central competent authority, or by contractual obligation under its financing agreements or from the TikTok MCN agency's cross-border payment partners.
statutory_audit_and_accounting_mandate.governing_accounting_framework: Taiwan Financial Reporting Standards (TFRS), which are converged with IFRS as endorsed by the Financial Supervisory Commission (FSC); entities below the mandatory IFRS threshold may apply Tier 2 SME financial reporting standards (TFRS for Small and Medium-sized Enterprises); all statutory books and financial statements must comply with the Commercial Accounting Act and Regulations on Business Accounting Standards.

corporate_registers_and_ubo_annual_confi.ubo_annual_confirmation_protocol: Taiwan does not maintain a standalone public UBO register, but every company must maintain an internal Register of Members (Shareholders) and Register of Beneficial Owners or controlling shareholders for annual inspection by the Ministry of Economic Affairs and tax authorities. Any share transfer: including changing of the registered shareholder, inherited ownership, or any transfer effecting beneficial ownership, must be filed with the MOEA Company Registration Office within 15 days of the transfer resolution or closing, and the tax authority must be updated in the same calendar month. In addition, the company must disclose significant controlling shareholders, senior managers, and ultimate beneficial owners in the annual corporate filings with the MOEA and in the tax declaration. A 30-day reporting window applies for any change in the shareholding register or capital structure. Failure to update the shareholder register is subject to fines of NTD 10,000-50,000 (approximately USD 330-1,650) per instance and the management of the WFOE may be penalized.

recurring_annual_maintenance_budget_usd.registered_office_or_agent_market_range_: USD 800 to USD 2,500 per year for registered address and professional corporate secretarial agent services in Taipei or major Taiwanese cities
recurring_annual_maintenance_budget_usd.statutory_audit_estimated_fee_usd: USD 3,000 to USD 8,000 per year for a licensed CPA audit of a WFOE with turnover below NTD 100 million, rising to USD 8,000 to USD 15,000 for larger cross-border MCN agency entities with multi-currency revenue streams
